stories.tz: 利雅得机场遭胡塞武装袭击致12死数百伤
stories.sz: 唐纳德·特朗普正在评估美国是否应加入沙特对伊朗支持的也门反政府武装的打击行动。沙特首都利雅得国际机场遭遇最新袭击，造成12人死亡、300多人受伤，民防部门表示……

stories.t: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
stories.s: Roofs were ripped off buildings after Isaias barrelled into the US on Friday evening, before it weakened to a post-tropical cyclone.
stories.tz: 飓风“伊斯雷亚斯”袭击美国造成4人死亡、数千户断电
stories.sz: “伊斯雷亚斯”于周五傍晚携狂风暴雨登陆美国，多处建筑屋顶被掀翻，随后减弱为后热带气旋。

stories.t: Young men live in fear of being snatched off the streets and sold to Myanmar's army
stories.s: A desperate junta is in a war of attrition against ethnic militias and and civilian resistance.
stories.tz: 缅甸年轻男子生活在被强行抓壮丁并卖给军方的恐惧中
stories.sz: 深陷绝境的缅甸军政府正与地方民族武装及民间抵抗力量进行持久消耗战。

stories.t: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
stories.s: A reenactment of the Battle of Hastings, which took place almost a millennium ago, is drawing crowds of enthusiasts in the UK.
stories.tz: 贝叶挂毯伦敦巡展激发爱好者重演黑斯廷斯战役
stories.sz: 一场几乎在千年前发生过的黑斯廷斯战役重演活动正在英国吸引大批爱好者。

stories.t: Trump weighs joining the fight against Houthis after Riyadh airport attack
stories.s: The surge in attacks, including against other Saudi airports, military facilities and oil infrastructure, has come in the week since a Saudi-led coalition launched a major military offensive against the Houthis.
stories.tz: 利雅得机场遭袭后，特朗普考虑加入打击胡塞武装的行列
stories.sz: 在沙特领导的多国联军对胡塞武装发动大规模军事攻势一周之际，包括针对其他沙特机场、军事设施和石油基础设施在内的袭击激增。

stories.t: Protests against voter roll revisions rock capital of world's largest democracy
stories.s: Parts of the capital city of India, the world's largest democracy, are on lockdown. Protests over sweeping revisions to the voter rolls were met with a massive police crackdown.
stories.tz: 抗议选民名册修改的示威活动震动世界最大民主国家首都
stories.sz: 作为世界最大民主国家的印度，其首都部分地区处于封锁状态。针对选民名册大幅修改的抗议活动遭到警方的大规模镇压。

stories.t: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people
stories.s: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.
stories.tz: 俄罗斯对扎波罗热发动滑翔炸弹袭击致至少20人死亡
stories.sz: 弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，这次造成儿童死亡的袭击是俄罗斯对美国柴油协议表达的“谢意”。

stories.t: Watch: 'Time for Ukraine to get a new president', says Trump
stories.s: The US president's said President Volodymyr Zelensky "wants to make problems for the world".
stories.tz: 视频：特朗普称“是时候让乌克兰换个新总统了”
stories.sz: 这位美国前总统表示，总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基“想给世界制造麻烦”。

stories.t: Money, networks and bias: Why women struggle to win seats in US politics
stories.s: The US is holding Congress and state governor elections. At all levels of US politics, women are underrepresented — but they may win some historic victories in the midterms on November 3.
stories.tz: 资金、网络与偏见：女性为何在美国政坛艰难赢得席位
stories.sz: 美国正在举行国会和州长选举。在各级美国政治中，女性的代表性依然不足，但她们可能会在11月3日的中期选举中取得一些历史性的胜利。

stories.t: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
stories.s: Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.
stories.tz: 美国死刑犯克里斯塔·派克在死刑执行失败10天后出院
stories.sz: 派克的律师表示，她对上个月在经历两次注射死刑幸存后照顾她的医疗团队表示“感激”。

stories.t: Thousands gather in London to express support for Palestinians after three years of ‘genocide’
stories.s: Twenty arrested in first march since Ed Miliband declared UK’s position was that Israel’s occupation of West Bank was unlawful Thousands of people have gathered in central London to express their support for Palestinians after three years…
stories.tz: 数千人聚集伦敦表达对巴勒斯坦的支持，抗议长达三年的“种族灭绝”
stories.sz: 在埃德·米利班德宣布英国立场即以色列对约旦河西岸的占领非合法之后，首场游行中有20人被捕。数千名民众聚集在伦敦市中心，在三年之后表达对巴勒斯坦人的支持……

stories.t: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'
stories.s: Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".
stories.tz: 诺贝尔和平奖得主称美国对国际刑事法院的制裁“不可接受”
stories.sz: 纳维·皮莱表示，特朗普政府对国际法庭实施的大规模严厉惩罚是“前所未有”的。

stories.t: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
stories.s: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.
stories.tz: 波兰一周内发生第三起学校持刀袭击事件，一名女子致三人受伤
stories.sz: 此前两天内连续发生两起袭击事件（造成一名女看守死亡、多人受伤）后，波兰警方已向各大学校部署警力。

stories.t: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
stories.s: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.
stories.tz: 人权组织称苏丹准军事组织在埃塞俄比亚边境附近发动无人机袭击，造成41人死亡
stories.sz: 据称死者中包括8名儿童，袭击目标是一个流离失所者聚集地。

stories.t: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
stories.s: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".
stories.tz: 特朗普宣布达成俄罗斯柴油协议，泽连斯基称其为送给普京的礼物
stories.sz: 乌克兰总统对这一举动进行了严厉批评，称其为“必须结束而不是延长战争的投资”。

stories.t: Why have hundreds of 'cockroach' protesters been detained in Delhi
stories.s: Thousands of security personnel were deployed in Delhi ahead of the Gen-Z led Cockroach Janta Party protest on Saturday calling for electoral reforms.
stories.tz: 德里为何有数百名“小强”抗议者被捕
stories.sz: 在周六由“Z世代”领导的“小强政党”（Cockroach Janta Party）呼吁进行选举改革的抗议活动前夕，德里部署了数千名安保人员。

stories.t: Candidate named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
stories.s: Leftwing Hitler Mussolini Simeon Flores beats far-right candidate in election in remote district of Andes A businessman called Hitler Mussolini Simeon Flores has been elected the mayor of a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, according…
stories.tz: 秘鲁当选市长名为“希特勒·墨索里尼”
stories.sz: 据安第斯山脉偏远地区选举结果显示，左翼候选人希特勒·墨索里尼·西蒙·弗雷洛斯击败了极右翼候选人。一名名为希特勒·墨索里尼·西蒙·弗雷洛斯的商人在秘鲁安第斯山脉的一个偏远地区当选为市长，据……

stories.t: U.S. and Russia tout diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows
stories.s: Moscow and Washington tout a diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows, but few details leave questions on price impacts and U.S. policy, sparking anger from Ukraine and allies.
stories.tz: 美俄兜售柴油协议以缓和制裁并恢复燃料供应
stories.sz: 莫斯科和华盛顿正兜售一项旨在缓和制裁并恢复燃料供应的柴油协议，但缺乏细节引发了对价格影响和美国政策的质疑，并招致乌克兰及盟友的愤怒。

stories.t: ‘Cockroach’ leader among thousands detained in Delhi protest crackdown
stories.s: Authorities impose strict lockdown in capital to try to stop rally against removal of 130m names from electoral roll Indian authorities have placed Delhi under a severe lockdown and detained tens of thousands of people, including the…
stories.tz: 德里抗议镇压中数千人被捕，其中包括“蟑螂”运动领导人
stories.sz: 当局在首都实施严格封锁，试图阻止抗议将1.3亿个名字从选民名册中剔除的集会。印度当局已对德里实施严厉封锁，并拘留了数万人，其中包括……

stories.t: Public executions in the US stopped nearly a century ago - why are they resuming now?
stories.s: The Pentagon says the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan will be livestreamed, but experts suggest officials are reading the country wrong.
stories.tz: 美国公开处决近一个世纪前已停止——为何现在恢复？
stories.sz: 五角大楼表示将对胡德堡枪击案枪手尼达尔·哈桑的死刑进行直播，但专家认为官员们误读了国家的情绪。

stories.t: Photos: What a year of ceasefire in Gaza looks like
stories.s: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.
stories.tz: 组图：加沙停火一年后的现状
stories.sz: 自哈马斯释放剩余以色列人质且特朗普总统承诺结束战争以来已经过去一年，但巴勒斯坦人表示，过去的12个月只是名义上的停火。

stories.t: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
stories.s: The protests focus on the Election Commission's voter list revision, which the opposition claims disenfranchises millions. The government denies the allegations, saying the revision aims to eliminate duplicate entries.
stories.tz: 面对针对莫迪及选举主管日益高涨的怒火，印度加紧镇压青年抗议活动
stories.sz: 抗议活动的焦点是选举委员会的选民名册修订工作，反对派称此举剥夺了数百万人的投票权。政府否认这些指控，称修订旨在消除重复登记。

stories.t: Is China seeking to restrict Taiwan's cultural presence?
stories.s: From coffee competitions to literature awards, Beijing appears to be working to limit Taiwan's international cultural and political impact.
stories.tz: 中国是否正试图限制台湾的文化存在？
stories.sz: 从咖啡比赛到文学奖项，北京似乎正致力于限制台湾在国际上的文化和政治影响力。

stories.t: How the Houthi-Saudi conflict is affecting countries on Africa's Red Sea coast — and beyond
stories.s: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which Yemeni government forces are trying to take back from the Houthis, is located not far from Djibouti and other African states.
stories.tz: 胡塞武装与沙特冲突如何影响非洲红海沿岸及其他地区国家
stories.sz: 也门政府军正试图从胡塞武装手中夺回控制权的曼德海峡，距离吉布提和其他非洲国家并不远。

stories.t: How the trial of murdered Australian brothers and US friend unfolded
stories.s: The mother of two Australian surfers murdered in Mexico two years ago with their American friend said "accountability matters".
stories.tz: 澳大利亚兄弟与美国好友在墨遭谋杀案审判细节披露
stories.sz: 两年前在墨西哥被谋杀的两名澳大利亚冲浪者的母亲与其美国好友表示，“追究责任至关重要”。

stories.t: ‘Like a drill going into my eye’: why the mystery over Havana syndrome refuses to die
stories.s: Dozens of CIA officers have been afflicted by debilitating symptoms over the past decade. Are they the result of ‘mass hysteria’? Or are they from attacks with an energy weapon and, if so, who is responsible? And has there been a cover-up?…
stories.tz: “犹如电钻钻眼”：为何有关“哈瓦那综合征”的谜团挥之不去
stories.sz: 在过去的十年里，数十名美国中情局官员受到衰弱症状的困扰。这些症状是“群体性癔症”的结果吗？还是能量武器袭击造成的？如果是，谁应负责？是否存在掩盖行为？……

stories.t: Nord Stream trial: How German police followed the evidence - to Ukraine
stories.s: After four years, a Ukrainian man is set to stand trial in Hamburg accused of sabotaging the Nord Stream pipelines.
stories.tz: “北溪”管道案审判：德国警方如何顺藤摸瓜锁定乌克兰
stories.sz: 经过四年的调查，一名乌克兰男子即将在汉堡受审，他被指控破坏“北溪”天然气管道。

stories.t: Flydubai attacker began a 'drift towards extremism and terrorism' in Australia, UAE says
stories.s: The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general also alleges the co-pilot was trying to crash the plane into Tel Aviv's airport.
stories.tz: 阿联酋称迪拜航空袭击者在澳大利亚开始“滑向极端主义和恐怖主义”
stories.sz: 阿联酋总检察长还指控该副驾驶曾试图驾驶飞机撞向特拉维夫机场。
